_comment: Resolved server-side by TradeSchoolMessages and sent as a translatableWithFallback, so unmodded clients read them in their own language and modded clients translate locally. §-codes highlight only the pertinent detail — the enchantment, or the limitation — so the eye lands on what changed rather than on the whole sentence.
enchantment.tradeschool.curse_of_copyrig: Prevents villagers from learning this enchantment
tradeschool.refusal.netherite: Villagers cannot learn to craft §enetherite§r items.
